stock-bullet-spray.head: 50d8572600b0f5371b91e2865c13f2588c406b14
stock-bullet-spray.scope: Stock Bullet Spray in SMG style hit the selected Melee Dummy for 91 and naturally applied Enraged 93 for eight seconds. The single target supplies no cone boundary evidence.

stock-suppression-fire.head: 3e298717c9dc1bca1622bd82ac7b4fbc9f987eb1
stock-suppression-fire.scope: Stock Suppression Fire activated from rest in SMG style, hit the selected Melee Dummy for 104 and applied Rooted 99 for the server-reported 21.12 seconds. Break behavior and cone geometry were not sampled.

stock-wounding-shot.head: 50d8572600b0f5371b91e2865c13f2588c406b14
stock-wounding-shot.scope: Stock Wounding Shot hit the selected Melee Dummy for 70, followed by the observed neutral DOT total 14 and four-point ticks. The stun did not proc in this sample.

stock-three-round-burst.head: 3e298717c9dc1bca1622bd82ac7b4fbc9f987eb1
stock-three-round-burst.scope: Stock Three Round Burst activated in Rifles interlock with the selected dummy Staggered and shared reuse clear. It hit for 76; its terminal callback naturally applied Stun 102 for four seconds on the next resolved round. Immunity presentation and ILDB playback were not observed.

stock-full-auto-redux.head: 3e298717c9dc1bca1622bd82ac7b4fbc9f987eb1
stock-full-auto-redux.scope: Stock Full Auto Redux activated in SMG interlock with the selected dummy Dazed, hit for 94 and applied both -15 accuracy modifiers (522 and 524) for eight seconds to that recipient.

proc.source: GOB 247 stores a 15% landing proc for eight seconds of Enraged.
